laws.rule: Cozia National Park: a visit ticket is charged (the park publishes it as a 10 lei ticket); amount and exemptions are posted at visitor centres and sale points. Legal basis OUG 57/2007. (No RBA rate for RON; at the Banca Națională a României rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 3.355 RON: 10 lei ≈ A$2.98)
